verdict.rationale: Statsig documents both client and server SDKs that log exposures (checkGate docs), says data can flow in with "a few lines of code," offers web analytics with autocapture events, and provides an HTTP API for logging events without an SDK. The pack never lists which languages or platforms the SDKs cover, and nothing confirms mobile SDKs or explicit custom-event logging calls. missing for 10: an enumerated list of official SDKs across major languages, evidence of mobile SDKs, explicit SDK custom-event logging documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
